business_profile.neighborhood_landmarks: Opposite 12th Main Post Office, near 100ft Road junction
business_profile.founder_background: Former corporate tech product lead who trained in sourdough fermentation in Pondicherry before opening his neighborhood micro-bakery.

core_offerings.name: 36-Hour Wild Ferment Sourdough
core_offerings.description: Slow-fermented naturally leavened bread made with stone-ground flour, water, sea salt, and our 5-year-old sourdough starter. Zero commercial yeast, zero chemical conditioners.
core_offerings.schedule: Warm loaves out of the oven at 7:30 AM and 3:30 PM daily

core_offerings.name: Single-Estate Specialty Coffee
core_offerings.description: Directly sourced arabica beans from small family plantations in Chikmagalur and Biligirirangana Hills, roasted light-to-medium weekly and pulled on a manual lever machine.
popular_items: Iced Filter Roast with Oat Milk

core_offerings.name: Daily Kitchen & Breakfast Plates
core_offerings.description: Simple, unpretentious morning and afternoon food built around our fresh bread and locally grown farm produce.
popular_items: Smoked Chicken Salad on Toasted Rye
Brioche French Toast with Local Wild Honey

atmosphere_and_values.vibe: Warm, sunny, book-filled, quiet morning work haven, buzzier evening cafe
amenities: Individual power outlets at all wall tables
atmosphere_and_values.pet_policy: Dogs and cats welcome in the outdoor verandah; water bowls and organic treats provided
atmosphere_and_values.laptop_policy: Laptops welcome in indoor seating weekdays until 6 PM; on weekends we ask guests to keep main dining tables laptop-free during peak brunch (11 AM - 3 PM)

tone_parameters.voice: The real founder talking directly to a neighbor
writing_principles: Use concrete sensory details (baking time, flour origin, crust sound, bean notes) instead of empty buzzwords ('delicious', 'exquisite').
Speak in first-person plural ('we') and occasional first-person singular ('I').
Be transparent about policies, pricing, and ingredients without corporate disclaimers.
Sound humble, friendly, and deeply committed to craft.
